surf_outcome.note: Reason: crest lowered from -1.0 to -1.5 m AHD by the council before construction (Blacka p.94; Swellnet says "1 m") so that the reef is too deep for consistent breaking; non-uniform container placement; reef lives only in long-period clean swell at low tide. Quotes: "disappointing in its secondary objective to improve surfing" (Wikipedia, card R9); "surfers seldom surf the reef" (Swellnet 2019, card R14); "the change would have no effect on sand accretion but was terminal to Narrowneck becoming a good surfing reef" (Swellnet 2017). Reef broke waves "roughly 50% of the time", faces 0.7-2.0 m, average ride 150-200 m / 30 s, "fun, but not hollow" (EcoShape via card R6); rides up to 60 s onto the adjacent sandbars (Corbett 2010a via Mead & Borrero 2011 p.3).

surfable_days_per_year.note: not stated for Narrowneck; EcoShape (card R6) says the reef broke waves about 50 % of the time (basis unknown).

durability.value: containers stable to 8-10 m waves; nine storms with H>5 m by 2002; settlement 1-2 m locally (weir containers up to 2 m); damage by anchors, spears, knives, boards; composite geotextile used in later bags; renewal 2017-18 (84 containers); Cyclone Oma Feb 2019 erosion (beach)
